Name: Custom NPC-MouriRan - Better English Translation
Author: Jaffe26
Description:
As the original EN translation of this mod was a bit rough, so I've redone the translations as best as I can.

[left]Note that this translation [b]is not perfect [/b]as machine translation was used. But I proof-read the translated dialogues so that it will all make sense in-game.

[b]This is a translation only.[/b] If you don't have the mod yet, you can download it [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29983]here[/url]. [/left]
[left]How to install: [/left]
[list=1]
[*]Download and Extract the Zip File. 
[*]Copy and Paste the extracted i8n folder to your [CP] MouriRan folder.
[/list]
For any translation errors, feel free comment it on the posts section so that I can make the corrections on the next update.

Credits to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/ohhhhhovo?gameId=1303]ohhhhhovo[/url]﻿ for making this wonderful mod.
And to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Anicebaby?gameId=1303]Anicebaby[/url] on making the original EN translation.
